faq: What if I do not have a defined brand voice?
That is fine. We read your site and emails, suggest two or three tone options with samples, and you pick one. We refine it from your feedback during the revision rounds.
Can the tone change between situations?
Yes. A greeting can be warm, an apology careful and a refusal brief. We set the rules for each situation, so the tone feels natural and not the same line repeated.
Will a strong tone make answers less accurate?
It should not. Tone rules shape wording, not facts. We test that answers stay correct and that the style does not lead to made-up details.
Do you work on a chatbot I already have?
Yes, if we can edit its instructions or settings. If your chatbot tool does not allow tone settings, we tell you that before you order.
